This vignette outlines the intended pipeline:

1) Screen items  
2) EFA (parallel analysis, oblimin)  
3) CFA (measurement-only)  
4) Reliability & validity (CR, AVE, HTMT)  
5) Nomological SEM (theory-driven)  
6) Invariance (if groups)  
7) Report (decision log)
